steps.code:
# Let's process each task: fetch comments, find if someone agreed, reassign and comment
import re

# Define positive indicators
positive_patterns = [
    r"can take",
    r"I can",
    r"bandwidth",
    r"take this task",
    r"will take",
    r"able to",
    r"happy to",
    r"yes",
]

for proj_id, t in all_tasks:
    task_id = t['task_id']
    comments = apis.todoist.show_task_comments(task_id=task_id, access_token=access_token)
    # Find a positive response from someone other than Paul
    agreed_person = None
    for c in comments:
        if c['user']['email'] == my_email:
            continue  # skip Paul's own comments
        content_lower = c['content'].lower()
        if any(re.search(p, content_lower) for p in positive_patterns):
            agreed_person = c['user']
            break
    if agreed_person:
        print(f"Task {task_id} ({t['title']}) -> agreed by {agreed_person['name']} ({agreed_person['email']})")
    else:
        print(f"Task {task_id} ({t['title']}) -> no one agreed")

instruction: At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Thanks <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.
